title: Call Budget
briefMd:
# Call Budget

The Agent runtime still kills at 8 steps / 12 calls. This exercise is tighter: **at most 3 tool calls** on the log (class A).

`tasks.json` has a calculator line and a json_store put. Hit both with the matching args, then **stop**. Extra `calculator("0")` probes, retries of a success, or a fourth call fail the call budget — even if the gold tools already hit.

Wall-clock is information, not a pass gate. Cost still goes through `BudgetEnforcer`. Echoing canaries fails.

source.description: Python 3 agent executed as main.py inside the sandbox
